class=\"post-body entry-content float-container\" id=\"post-body-6823161391685146580\"\u003E\u003Cspan face=\"Roboto, sans-serif\"\u003EThis is an online E log book to discuss our patient's de-identified health data shared after taking his\/her\/guardian's signed informed consent. Here we discuss our individual patient's problems through series of inputs from available global online community of experts with an aim to solve those patient's clinical problems with collective current best evidence based inputs. This E log book also reflects my patient-centered online learning portfolio.\u003C\/span\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003Cdiv\u003E63 year old housewife from Nalgonda\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EChief complaints- Vomiting 5 episodes 3 days ago\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHistory of present illness-\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient was apparently alright 1 year back then developed vomiting associated with giddiness and pain. she came to our hospital and vomiting subsided with treatment. She was asked to take Vertin 24 (betahistine) at discharge. she took the medication for 3 months and then stopped after consulting with her physician. She had mild episodes of vomiting for the next months until 3 days back when she had 5 episodes (severe)\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EVomiting- non projectile, contents were food\/watery. there was no blood present in the vomitus. no temporal association with meal timings was noticed. it was associated with giddiness and colicky, non radiating pain in the epigastrium, present only during the episode. Not associated with fever, headache, diarrhoea or constipation.\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EFrequency of stools are normal but volume is decreased due to less food intake out of fear of vomiting.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo history of- abdominal distention, heart burn, acidity, excessive flatulence, jaundice.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EGiddiness- there was no history of headache, trauma, fall, stroke, aural fullness, tinnitus, no positional variation or triggering factors (starts randomly). no aggravating factors. relieved with medications.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPast history-\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient is a known case of hypertension since 5 years, is on medication Telma Greeshma\u0026nbsp;\u003Cdiv\u003ERoll no : 148\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003EIntroduction:\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/b\u003E65yrs old male came to gen medicine department with chief complaints of bilateral pain and swelling since 10 days , bilateral loin pain since 10 days, fever and chills since 8 days ,bilateral pain in inguinal region since\u0026nbsp; 5 days ,loose stools since 3 days .\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003EHISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS:\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient\u0026nbsp;was apparently asymptomatic\u0026nbsp;10 days back ,then he developed complaints of\u0026nbsp; bilateral pedal edema pitty type associated with pain and redness with local rise in temperature .he also had bilateral loin pain 10 days\u0026nbsp; back later he had complaints of fever associated with chills, intermittent,no diurnal variation since 5 days ,he had complaints of pain in\u0026nbsp; bilateral inguinal region\u0026nbsp; for which with all above complaints he was taken to hospital and was diagnosed as AKI on CKD\u0026nbsp; with bilateral lower limb cellulitis , he also had loose stools 3 days back\u0026nbsp; watery not associated with blood\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;which resolved now .\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003EHISTORY OF PAST ILLNESS:\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHistory of blood urine 1 year back\u0026nbsp; after one day resolved on medication\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EN\/k\/c\/o\u0026nbsp; - HTN , DM , TB , asthma\/CAD \/ epilepsy \/ CVA\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EH\/o trauma to back after a fall and managed conservatively\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003EPERSONAL HISTORY:\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EMarried\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EDiet: mixed\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAppetite: normal\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EBowel movements: regular\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EBladder movements: regular\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ESleep: adequate\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAddictions: alcohol ,tobacco\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003EFAMILY HISTORY:\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENot k\/c\/o DM ,HTN, asthma,tb\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003EPHYSICAL \u003C\/b\u003EEXAMINATION\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003EGeneral examination:\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo pallor\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo\u0026nbsp; icterus\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo cyanosis\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo clubbing\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPedal edema\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Ci\u003EVITALS\u003C\/i\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ETemperature: 98.7F\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPulse rate: 80\/ min\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ERespiration rate: 12 per min\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EBp: 120\/80 mm Hg\u003C\/div\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003ESystemic examination:\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003ECVS\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo thrills\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ES1S2 present\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo murmurs\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003ERespiratory examination:\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo dyspnea\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo wheezing\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPosition of trachea is central\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EBreath sounds are vesicular\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003EAbdominal examination:\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EShape of abdomen- scaphoid\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo tenderness\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo palpable mass\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHernial orifices are normal\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ELiver not palpable\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ESpleen not palpable\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EBowel sounds no\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003ECNS\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003Elevel of consciousness- conscious\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ESpeech normal\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ESigns of meningeal irritation:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; a) no neck stiffness\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; b) no kernigs sign\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ECranial nerves normal\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003Emotor system normal\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ESensory system normal\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003EReflexes\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAll are normal\u003C\/div\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003EProvisional diagnosis:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/b\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAKI on CKD\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003ETreatment:\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EI.V fluids NS @ 100ml\/hr\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EInj LASIX 40 mg \/i.v \/bd\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EInj.PIPTAZ 4.5 gm \/ i.v \/ stat\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both;
